title: A Speculative Parallel DFA Membership Test for Multicore, SIMD and Cloud Computing Environments
relevance: Used SIMD gather operations for indexed memory loads in vectorized DFA state transition computation. Demonstrates that gather-based pattern processing achieves near-linear speedups.

title: Parsing gigabytes of JSON per second
relevance: simdjson's Stage 2 processes structural index entries sequentially. Gather-scatter routing could batch-process multiple entries in parallel, accelerating Stage 2.

title: cuJSON: A Highly Parallel JSON Parser for GPUs
relevance: GPU tokenization uses coalesced memory access patterns analogous to gather-scatter on CPUs. cuJSON's parallel token classification mirrors the batch classification in this concept.

title: AVX512/VBMI2: A Programmer's Perspective
relevance: Practical examples of using AVX-512 gather/scatter for database operations on scattered data. Demonstrates real-world performance characteristics of gather instructions.
